title: Questions 186-190 refer to the following e-mails and advertisement.
passage_1:
To:events@harborstonecatering.com
From:e.brandt@kingfisherwealth.com
Date:2 June
Subject:Enquiry

To the Events Director,

The consultation firm I work for is interested in having your company handle the catering for its client events. For the past six years, Kingfisher Wealth Advisors has considered Cobalt Kitchen for all its functions. However, we have learned that Cobalt Kitchen will be moving to Bristol. As we prefer to work with a local supplier, I decided to contact you.

We have a major investor evening on 4 July, and we need catering for 200 guests with a seated dinner service. Would you be interested in taking on this event? If it goes well, we would be glad to build a long-term partnership with your company.

Sincerely,
Elias Brandt
Office Manager, Kingfisher Wealth Advisors

To:e.brandt@kingfisherwealth.com
From:n.fournier@kingfisherwealth.com
Date:18 June
Subject:Re: Autumn Campaign

Dear Mr. Brandt,

I have looked over your draft of our firm’s promotional brochure and have a suggestion.

As the market is so crowded at the moment, I think the wording needs a small change. Rather than mentioning our low management fees, I suggest you emphasise our long-term planning expertise. Clients want to know that their plans are built on careful modelling, not guesswork.

Regarding your assistant’s idea of putting that detail in a separate box at the foot of the page, I think it’s excellent. It will certainly appeal to newly retired professionals.

Best,
Nadia Fournier

KINGFISHER WEALTH ADVISORS: PLAN WITH CONFIDENCE

Offices: Harbour Quarter

Are you ready to put your finances on a firmer setting? Work with the firm that plans for the long view.

Why Choose Us?

  • Long View: We use detailed long-term modelling when building every client plan.
  • Memorable Events: We are delighted to announce our new partnership with Harborstone Catering to host client evenings of the highest standard.
  • Trusted Team: We employ award-winning advisers dedicated to our clients’ goals.

Start Today:

We are currently offering a free first consultation to all newly retired clients. To book your appointment, please call our reception on 555-0184.
